Today it is up about 2% in a relief bounce helped by cheaper oil, while Nvidia falls about 5% over a probe involving its CEO. Junk-bond credit is weakening and leadership has moved to health care, staples and payments, so I stay with steady, high-quality companies that don't depend on AI and avoid chasing the chip bounce.
